parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv just rolled a 9, which is exactly the number I blocked with the robber. His city on node 41 would have given him 2 wheat, and my settlement on 14 would have given me 1. Even though I'm losing out, it's a bigger blow to Ziv. Shon is the only one who actually gets wheat from this roll (node 18). Ziv's comment about the dice 'pampering' us is ironic given that his best number is blocked.
